description: This file defines an interface `ILogConsistencyDiagnostics` for diagnostic and statistics collection in log-consistent grains, and a class `LogConsistencyStatistics` that holds related statistical data.

classes.name: LogConsistencyStatistics
classes.description: A collection of statistics for grains using log-consistency, including event counters and stabilization latencies.

methods.name: EnableStatsCollection
methods.description: Method to turn on statistics collection for log-consistent grains.

methods.name: DisableStatsCollection
methods.description: Method to turn off statistics collection.

methods.name: GetStats
methods.description: Method to retrieve the collected log consistency statistics.
